## Decision

The stored thesis (version 2) is **invalidated**. The customer-loss event disclosed in **FIL-201** on 2026-07-29 confirms that customer **C-17**, representing **31 percent** of revenue, will not renew its contract. This crosses the stored invalidation threshold defined in **THS-211**, which mandates invalidation when any single customer above **25 percent** of revenue is lost. The conservative governance response in **RSK-221** directs that the research state be set to **invalidated** at **expected_version 2**, with no target-price estimate attempted.

1. **State transition**: Move the research state from ACTIVE → **INVALIDATED** at thesis version **2**, with the effective date of 2026-07-29 matching FIL-201.
